content:
The image shows a soybean pod/stem area with prominent white fluffy mycelial growth covering the tissue. There are also what appear to be small dark sclerotia embedded within the white mold. The surrounding leaves in the background show yellowing. The white cottony/fluffy growth on the stem and pod tissue is the defining visual feature.

This matches White Mold (Sclerotinia stem rot) precisely: fluffy white mold growth on soybean stems/pods with black sclerotia embedded within, and the characteristic white mycelial mass on pod tissue.
